The role includes preparing and delivering lectures, assessing student performance, mentoring students, developing curriculum, engaging in research and publications, participating in departmental committees, and supporting institutional activities. The incumbent is expected to uphold academic integrity, foster critical thinking, and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive learning environment.. The appointment will enhance research productivity, strengthen archival and heritage studies, improve student mentoring, and support accreditation and quality assurance initiatives.
